reasoning_traces.think:
The Sports-QA benchmark introduces a fundamental shift from coarse action recognition to fine-grained, temporally grounded reasoning. The core mathematical innovation is the Adaptive Focal Attention (AFA) mechanism, which addresses the multi-scale nature of sports dynamics. Standard self-attention treats all temporal distances equally, often diluting critical short-term kinematic cues (e.g., footwork) with irrelevant long-term background noise. AFA rectifies this by defining a set of discrete focal lengths $f$, effectively creating a bank of windowed attention operators. For any query token $q_j$, the attention map is constrained such that only keys within a temporal radius $|i-j| \le f$ contribute. These localized attention scores are then aggregated via a convex combination governed by learned mixing weights $\alpha_f$. This structure enforces a strict partition of unity over the temporal domain, allowing the network to dynamically allocate computational resources between immediate physical interactions and broader strategic context. In the context of GSE, this isomorphism is profound: a football play is inherently multi-scale. The chaotic, high-frequency collisions at the line of scrimmage require short focal lengths, whereas the unfolding of a deep passing route demands long-range temporal integration. The failure mode of AFA arises if the predefined focal lengths do not span the true characteristic timescales of the sport, or if the mixing weights collapse due to vanishing gradients, reverting the model to a naive average. To mitigate this, our proposed improvement experiment suggests making focal lengths learnable per attention head, conditioned on play context (e.g., down and distance), thereby transforming AFA from a static filter bank into a fully adaptive, context-aware differential operator.

reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Modeling opposing agents in sports requires inferring intent from partial, noisy trajectories. AFA acts as a cognitive prior: defenders operate on short focal lengths reacting to immediate ball carrier velocity, while quarterbacks utilize long focal lengths to anticipate receiver separation. The mixing weights $\alpha_f$ thus represent the agent's current cognitive load and strategic horizon, dynamically shifting based on the evolving game state.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: We must veto any direct application of AFA if the underlying video embeddings lack precise temporal synchronization. If tracking data is aliased or dropped, the strict window constraints $|i-j| \le f$ will introduce severe boundary artifacts. Furthermore, if the mixing weights become collinear with simple play-clock proxies, the model merely learns time-decay rather than genuine structural reasoning, necessitating a regularization term to enforce orthogonality between $\alpha_f$ and trivial temporal features.
